name.en-US: A Spiritual Consolation and The Ways to Perfect Religion
name.pt-BR: Uma Consolação Espiritual e Os Caminhos da Perfeição Religiosa

description.en-US: Two treatises written by Fisher in the Tower of London in 1534-35: a spiritual consolation to his sister Elizabeth, and the Ways to Perfect Religion, a comparison of the life of hunters with the life of religious followed by ten considerations on the religious state.
description.pt-BR: Dois tratados escritos por Fisher na Torre de Londres em 1534-35: uma consolação espiritual à sua irmã Elizabeth e os Caminhos da Perfeição Religiosa, uma comparação entre a vida dos caçadores e a dos religiosos, seguida de dez considerações sobre o estado religioso.

sources.edition: A spirituall consolation ... The wayes to perfect religion (London: 1578), EEBO-TCP A00776.
sources.description: EEBO-TCP hand-keyed transcription, original spelling kept. 49 illegible places in the source are marked […]. Raw TEI in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: St. John Fisher died in 1535; the edition is of 1578 and the TCP transcription is released to the public domain (CC0).
